reasoning: This is a multi-module Maven repo. It holds the TrustyAI core Java library (explainability-core, -arrow, -connectors), but what RHOAI ships from it is a container. Dockerfile.konflux packages only explainability-service/target/quarkus-app into a UBI9 OpenJDK 17 runtime image. explainability-service is a Quarkus REST service. It computes fairness metrics (SPD, DIR) and explainability, takes in KServe/ModelMesh inference payloads, exposes Prometheus metrics and health checks, and has OpenShift manifests. The trustyai-service-operator, a separate repo, deploys and manages it. The library modules are internal dependencies of this service, so the deployable artifact is a service.
